explication: OpenLineage is a cross-platform standard and set of libraries for collecting job, run, and dataset lineage while jobs execute, enriching it with facets, and sending events to configurable backends. The principal workflow is an instrumented job integration observing execution, assembling lineage metadata, and submitting events through a client transport. The tree also shows dataset-identification helpers and multiple language clients and transport options. README documents Airflow support, but no Airflow source path appears in the supplied tree; sampled excerpts are incomplete, so uncertain internal wiring is not asserted.
